name: NA Image ALT Helper
author: najir29

sections.description:
100% Free Auto ALT Text Generator is a powerful image accessibility and SEO optimization plugin for WordPress.

It automatically generates clean, context-aware ALT text for:

  • Media Library images
  • WooCommerce product images
  • Attached & unattached images
  • Bulk existing images
  • Newly uploaded images

This plugin improves both SEO and Accessibility (WCAG) by ensuring every image gets meaningful ALT text without any manual work.

🔥 Key Highlights

  • 100% Free — No API, No Tokens, No Hidden Limitations
  • Auto ALT text on upload
  • Bulk ALT generation for all existing images
  • Supports WooCommerce products
  • Uses post title, product category, keywords, SEO fields, and smart tokens
  • Optional overwrite mode
  • Detects SEO focus keyword from Yoast or Rank Math
  • Auto keyword extraction from post content
  • Clean & simple UI
  • Super lightweight — No external API calls
  • No performance impact

🧠 Smart Tokens You Can Use

You can customize your ALT template using tokens like:

{title}, `{filename}`, `{parent}`, `{parent_title}`, `{parent_category}`, `{parent_tags}`, `{product_cat}`, `{product_sku}`, `{seo_focus}`, `{auto_keywords}`, `{site}`, `{keywords}`

These tokens are automatically replaced with real post/product/context data.

🚀 Why This Plugin?

Most “ALT Generator” plugins are either:

❌ Paid
❌ API-based
❌ Limited
❌ Slow

This one is fast, free, local, and privacy-friendly.
Perfect for WooCommerce shops, portfolios, blogs — basically any site with images.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to Media → Auto ALT Text.
  4. Configure your template, keywords, and settings.
  5. Click Generate for All to bulk-generate missing ALT text.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use an external API?

No. 100% local processing. No API calls. No costs.

Will it slow down my website?

No. It only runs during ALT generation. Nothing runs on the front-end.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Fully compatible.

Does it support Yoast or Rank Math keywords?

Yes. If enabled, the SEO focus keyword is used in ALT text.

Can I overwrite existing ALT text?

Yes — there is an option for that.

Does it generate ALT text automatically on upload?

Yes.
